title: PRS Artist Series
caption: 1991 PRS Artist Series - Blue
details: My main studio and live guitar since 1992. This is production # 66 in the original Artist Series. “I've owned this very special guitar since about 1992 and have played it on every recording and most tours ever since. While some of my other guitars are better for specific things, the PRS Custom 24 is a great and wonderfully balanced instrument that is good at many things. It's the guitar I reach for the most in the studio.” (Interview with gitarrebass.de)

title: PRS Standard
caption: 1991 PRS Standard - Black
details: This one gets used a lot for clean and Strat type sounds because of the split coil option.

title: PRS Brazilian Custom 24
caption: 2004 PRS Brazilian Custom 24 - Natural
details: Used primarily for dropped D tunings.

title: PRS Hollowbody
caption: 2008 PRS Hollowbody - Black
details: I use this a lot for semi-dirty/clean sounds and the occasional slide guitar section.

title: PRS McCarty SC-245
caption: 2009 PRS McCarty SC-245 - Sunburs
details: My choice when I want something with a less saturated, more vintage tone.

title: Gibson SG
caption: 1974 Gibson SG - Walnut
details: My first 'real' guitar. Doesn't get much use these days, but I try to use it at least once on every record.

title: Godin LGX
caption: 1998 Godin LGX - Black
details: A gift from my friend and former guitar tech, Takumi. I use this a lot for clean sounds in the studio, running the piezo pickup mono and dry, and the electric output to some stereo effect (e.g. Arch/Matheos- Neurotically Wired intro, OSI- Stockholm). “I often use the Godin for clean sounds. But it also has a great piezo sound. A typical way of working for me is to use the piezo directly and the guitar pickups for two stereo tracks. The effect is a broad, well-measured clean sound on the left and right and an acoustic tone in the middle. I've used the Godin countless times on Fates Warning, OSI and also on my Arch/Matheos project.” (Interview with gitarrebass.de)

title: Ovation Elite 6 String
caption: 1988 Ovation Elite 6 string - Natural
details: My main acoustic from 1988 until the late 90s. I still use it a lot for writing and demos, but if I have any serious recording to do I'll usually borrow a Taylor or something.

title: Ovation Custom Balladeer 12 String
caption: 1984 Ovation Custom Balladeer 12 string - Natural
details: This guitar is pretty beat up but I still use it a lot. Sounds nice and is easy to play for a 12-string. Chasing Time, Eye To Eye, Island In The Stream…

title: Alvarez Yairi Classical
caption: 1973 Alvarez Yairi 5036 Classical
details: My first and only classical guitar. Still gets a lot of use.

title: Bouzouki
caption: 1995 Hand Made Bouzouki
details: Made for me by my friend and former guitar tech, Ed Picard. You can hear it on the Fates Warning song Heal Me, OSI- All Gone Now (with lots of distortion), and OSI - No Celebrations.

title: Gibson Explorer
caption: 1981 Gibson Explorer - White
details: Used heavily on the first 4 Fates Warning albums. Wish I never sold this one!

title: BC Rich Gunslinger
caption: 1989 custom made BC Rich Gunslinger - Black
details: Also one in white. Both used for the Perfect Symmetry tours and while writing Parallels.

title: Jackson Custom
caption: 1990 Jackson Custom - Green
details: This was actually Frank Aresti's guitar and was custom built for him. It had a built in JE-1500 preamp, which gave the guitar a nice mid-range/wah sound. You can hear it a lot on Parallels.

title: Steinberger GS
caption: 1990 Steinberger GS series with Transtrem - Blue
details: Used a lot for clean sounds on Parallels and Inside Out.
